thread:
pranav: Quick sync — postmortem for the svc-token-validator incident. We still have a handful of open action items across token validation tests, audit events, and secrets rotation. Link to postmortem: https://confluence.redwood/postmortems/svc-token-validator-2409. Can folks call ownership + ETA here?

anya: :raising_hand: I can own the token validation test harness and unit tests. Will PR by EOD today. Jira: IN-3827.

taylor: I'll take audit-log integration + retention policy. Plan: add structured JSON events and wire into kinesis/streaming pipeline. ETA 2024-03-31. @pranav do we need >90d retention for any product reason?

pranav: Legal scoped it to 90 days for now; escalate if compliance asks for more. Also we should add an invoice-level audit event for billing traces.

chen: I'll own the secrets rotation checklist for the service account keys and coordinate infra. ETA next Tue. Draft runbook at `docs/runbooks/rotate-svc-keys.md` (WIP).

sec-bot: Reminder: scheduled key rotation job failed 2024-03-22 14:02 — ticket IN-3840 created.

sam: :thumbsup: I'll run the canary rollout for the patched validator and monitor token miss rates + error spikes. Will do staging canary then prod; ETA tomorrow AM.

pranav: Capture verification criteria here: 1) no unexplained 401s for 24h post-deploy; 2) audit events include `token_validated: true/false` for all auth flows; 3) secrets rotated and verifiably absent from deploy nodes. Assign owners in Jira and mark tests that assert these.

anya: Created IN-3850 for unit-test PR -> https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/2850. Tests added for expired and malformed token branches.

taylor: Created IN-3851 for audit schema + kinesis wiring. Pushed schema draft: ```json
{"event":"token_check","status":"passed|failed","user_id":"...","timestamp":"...","request_id":"..."}
```

chen: Created IN-3852 runbook + rotation playbook — draft at https://confluence.redwood/rotate-keys. Need infra approval for rolling re-deploy.

pranav: I'll consolidate these into a single tracker and schedule a 15m sync tomorrow 10:15am PT. If you can't make it, post status updates here before the sync. Thanks.

pranav: One more note — recurring pattern observed: the validator cache eviction under high QPS causes token validation misses. Long-term action: evaluate auto-warm + eviction tuning and a fallback to a lighter-weight stateless check. I'll open IN-3853 for investigation.
